defects: No `Algebra R S` (or `Module R S`) instance is introduced — only a bare ring hom `f : R →+* S` is given, so `Module.Finite R S` in the hypotheses has no module structure to refer to and does not elaborate as intended

The conclusion `Finrank (Ideal.Quotient.field p) (Ideal.Quotient.field P)` passes `Field` instances (terms of type `Field (R ⧸ p)` / `Field (S ⧸ P)`) as if they were the underlying types themselves; `Module.finrank` expects the quotient ring types (e.g. `R ⧸ p`, `S ⧸ P`), not their `Field` instances — this is a type/category error

`Ideal.Quotient.field` requires `[I.IsMaximal]` to produce a `Field (R ⧸ I)` instance, but the statement only assumes `p.IsPrime` / `P.IsPrime`; under mere primality this instance does not exist, so the conclusion fails to typecheck as stated, unlike gold's `inertiaDeg'` which is meaningful for general primes

Uses `hLiesOver : Ideal.comap f P = p` as a plain hypothesis with an unconstrained `f`, rather than tying the module/algebra structure and the lying-over condition together via `algebraMap R S` (as gold's `[P.LiesOver p]` does), leaving the relationship between `f`, the module structure, and the finiteness hypothesis underspecified
